an10.76:1.1: bhikkhave dhammā loke na saṃvijjeyyuṃ, na Tathāgato loke uppajjeyya arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, na Tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dippeyya.
an10.76:1.3: Jāti ca jarā ca maraṇañ ca.
an10.76:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhammā loke na saṃvijjeyyuṃ, na Tathāgato loke uppajjeyya arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, na Tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dippeyya.
an10.76:1.5: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave ime tayo dhammā loke saṃvijjanti, tasmā Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, tasmā Tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dippati. 3.
an10.76:2.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo jātiṃ pahātuṃ jaraṃ pahātuṃ maraṇaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:2.3: Rāgaṃ appahāya dosaṃ appahāya mohaṃ appahāya,
an10.76:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo jātiṃ pahātuṃ jaraṃ pahātuṃ maraṇaṃ pahātuṃ. 5.
an10.76:3.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo rāgaṃ pahātuṃ dosaṃ pahātuṃ mohaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:3.3: Sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ appahāya vicikicchaṃ appahāya sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ appahāya,
an10.76:3.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo rāgaṃ pahātuṃ dosaṃ pahātuṃ mohaṃ pahātuṃ. 7.
an10.76:4.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ pahātuṃ vicikicchaṃ pahātuṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:4.3: Ayonisomanasikāraṃ appahāya kummaggasevanaṃ appahāya cetaso līnattaṃ appahāya,
an10.76:4.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ pahātuṃ vicikicchaṃ pahātuṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pahātuṃ. 9.
an10.76:5.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahātuṃ kummaggasevanaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso līnattaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:5.3: Muṭṭhasaccaṃ appahāya asampajaññaṃ appahāya cetaso vikkhepaṃ appahāya,
an10.76:5.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahātuṃ kummaggasevanaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso līnattaṃ pahātuṃ. 11.
an10.76:6.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:6.3: Ariyānaṃ adassanakamyataṃ appahāya ariyadhammaṃ asotukamyataṃ appahāya upārambhacittataṃ appahāya,
an10.76:6.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ. 13.
an10.76:7.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo ariyānaṃ adassanakamyataṃ pahātuṃ ariyadhammaṃ asotukamyataṃ pahātuṃ upārambhacittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:7.3: Uddhaccaṃ appahāya asaṃvaraṃ appahāya dussīlyaṃ appahāya,
an10.76:7.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo ariyānaṃ addassanakamyataṃ pahātuṃ ariyadhammaṃ asotukamyataṃ pahātuṃ upārambhacittataṃ pahātuṃ. 15.
an10.76:8.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:8.3: Assaddhiyaṃ appahāya avadaññutaṃ appahāya kosajjaṃ appahāya,
an10.76:8.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ. 17.
an10.76:9.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:9.3: Anādariyaṃ appahāya dovacassataṃ appahāya pāpamittataṃ appahāya,
an10.76:9.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ. 19.
an10.76:10.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:10.3: Ahirikaṃ appahāya anottappaṃ appahāya pamādaṃ appahāya,
an10.76:10.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ pahātuṃ. 21.
an10.76:11.2: So pamatto samāno abhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:11.3: So pāpamitto samāno abhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:11.4: So kusīto samāno abhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:11.5: So dussīlo samāno abhabbo ariyānaṃ adassanakamyataṃ pahātuṃ ariyadhammaṃ asotukamyataṃ pahātuṃ upārambhacittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:11.6: So upārambhacitto samāno abhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:11.7: So vikkhittacitto samāno abhabbo ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahātuṃ kummaggasevanaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso līnattaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:11.8: So līnacitto samāno abhabbo sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ pahātuṃ vicikicchaṃ pahātuṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:11.9: So vicikiccho samāno abhabbo rāgaṃ pahātuṃ dosaṃ pahātuṃ mohaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:11.10: Rāgaṃ appahāya dosaṃ appahāya mohaṃ appahāya abhabbo jātiṃ pahātuṃ jaraṃ pahātuṃ maraṇaṃ pahātuṃ. 22.
an10.76:12.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo jātiṃ pahātuṃ jaraṃ pahātuṃ maraṇaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:12.3: Rāgaṃ pahāya dosaṃ pahāya mohaṃ pahāya,
an10.76:12.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo jātiṃ pahātuṃ jaraṃ pahātuṃ maraṇaṃ pahātuṃ. 24.
an10.76:13.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo rāgaṃ pahātuṃ dosaṃ pahātuṃ mohaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:13.3: Sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ pahāya vicikicchaṃ pahāya sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pahāya,
an10.76:13.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo rāgaṃ pahātuṃ dosaṃ pahātuṃ mohaṃ pahātuṃ. 26.
an10.76:14.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ pahātuṃ vicikicchaṃ pahātuṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:14.3: Ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahāya kummaggasevanaṃ pahāya cetaso līnattaṃ pahāya,
an10.76:14.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ pahātuṃ vicikicchaṃ pahātuṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pahātuṃ. 28.
an10.76:15.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahātuṃ kummaggasevanaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso līnattaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:15.3: Muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahāya asampajaññaṃ pahāya cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahāya,
an10.76:15.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahātuṃ kummaggasevanaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso līnattaṃ pahātuṃ. 30.
an10.76:16.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:16.3: Ariyānaṃ adassanakamyataṃ pahāya ariyadhammaṃ asotukamyataṃ pahāya upārambhacittataṃ pahāya,
an10.76:16.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ. 32.
an10.76:17.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo ariyānaṃ adassanakamyataṃ pahātuṃ ariyadhammaṃ asotukamyataṃ pahātuṃ upārambhacittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:17.3: Uddhaccaṃ pahāya asaṃvaraṃ pahāya dussīlyaṃ pahāya,
an10.76:17.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo ariyānaṃ adassanakamyataṃ pahātuṃ ariyadhammaṃ asotukamyataṃ pahātuṃ upārambhacittataṃ pahātuṃ. 34.
an10.76:18.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:18.3: Assaddhiyaṃ pahāya avadaññutaṃ pahāya kosajjaṃ pahāya,
an10.76:18.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ. 36.
an10.76:19.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:19.3: Anādariyaṃ pahāya dovacassataṃ pahāya pāpamittataṃ pahāya,
an10.76:19.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ. 38.
an10.76:20.1: Tayo bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ.
an10.76:20.3: Ahirikaṃ pahāya anottappaṃ pahāya pamādaṃ pahāya,
an10.76:20.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ pahātuṃ. 40.
an10.76:21.2: So appamatto samāno bhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.3: So kalyāṇamitto samāno bhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.4: So āraddhaviriyo samāno bhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.5: So sīlavā samāno bhabbo ariyānaṃ adassanakamyataṃ pahātuṃ ariyadhammaṃ asotukamyataṃ pahātuṃ upārambhacittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.6: So anupārambhacitto samāno bhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.7: So avikkhittacitto samāno bhabbo ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahātuṃ kummaggasevanaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso līnattaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.8: So alīnacitto samāno bhabbo sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ pahātuṃ vicikicchaṃ pahātuṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pahātuṃ.
